thermal.note: Model inputs that differ between the boards: part positions, copper loss tiles, vias in the two gap-filler zones (141 and 139 on the current board, 86 and 77 on the ground-up board, so through-board conductivity there is set to 8.0 and 4.8 W/mK), and copper cover round the power stages (34 against 40 W/mK in-plane by copper area, so the model uses 38 and 45.6 W/mK). The third row takes that copper-cover credit away again. 25 °C ambient, still air, d44 derate policy, steps of 10 s.
